name: Cradle
description: A Wishing Well E.L.F. designed for pediatric augments. Generates subtle soothing vibrations during a child's distress — not enough to sedate, enough to comfort.
observed_behavior: Monitors stress biomarkers in children's augments and applies micro-haptic patterns associated with being held. The child feels something like being rocked.
story_hooks: An orphan with no memory of being held by a parent describes the sensation and a caretaker recognizes it as an E.L.F.
